_doc: Pass 2 build state — read this at the start of every /loop iteration. Update at the end.

scaffold._progress: Iter #1: scaffold complete (pass2.js + data registry + index.html switch). Iter #2: scaffold considered done — gameplay code lives in pass2.js for now; will split into shroud_combat.js / shroud_hud.js etc. organically as files grow past 1500 lines.
scaffold.deliverable: New gameplay-tier code split out of the 8461-line game.js: shroud_act1_data.js (rooms, NPCs, items, enemies, dungeon), shroud_combat.js (sword/bow/bombs/hitboxes), shroud_hud.js (hearts/rupees/keys/items), shroud_save.js. Loaded from index.html alongside game.js. Old narrative levels.json renamed acts_lore.json. New tile-based levels.json shape defined.

rooms_overworld._progress: Iter #2: 12 overworld rooms authored — Canopy Village (village_square, herbalist_hut, village_gate), Shrine Path (shrine_path_a/b/c), Emerald Thicket (thicket_a/b/c/waterfall/vine), ruins_entrance_overworld. All 18x11 validated. NPCs placed: Mira (square), Heda (herbalist), Dax (gate). Enemy spawn slots seeded across thicket. Heart-piece + rupee + weak-wall rewards seeded. Room graph reachability: 22/22 from spawn.
rooms_overworld.deliverable: 12 hand-authored rooms covering Canopy Village (4: square, herbalist hut, shrine path, gate), Emerald Thicket (5: meadow, fork, waterfall approach, vine wall, ruins entrance), Shrine Path (3). Tile data: 18x11 per room @ 16px = 288x176. Solid/grass/path/water/tree tiles. Edge-of-screen transitions wire neighbors.

rooms_dungeon._progress: Iter #2: 10 Ruins of First Light rooms authored — foyer (3-way fork), east_a (small_key drop), east_b (push-block + pit hazards), west_a (Thornback), west_b (Geomancer mini-boss + bombs reward), north_a (4-statue light puzzle), north_b (weak wall hides heart piece), big_key_room, boss_door, boss_room (Guardian + heart container). Locked-door (L) + big-door (B) tile codes gate progression. All 18x11 validated.
rooms_dungeon.deliverable: 10 rooms of the Ruins of First Light dungeon: entrance, 3 ante-rooms (puzzle + enemies), small-key room, mini-boss room (Geomancer Statue), dungeon-item room (Astral Blade level-2 OR Gale Boomerang), 2 puzzle rooms (push-block + 4-statue light puzzle), boss-key room, boss room (Guardian).

combat._progress: Iter #3 + #4: full combat layer shipped. Sword swing (hitbox in facing dir, 80-280ms active window of 380ms swing, multi-hit prevention) + knockback both directions + 800ms i-frames + flicker. Bow (X to fire when equipped): 8-arrow pool, 220px/s, embeds in walls 500ms, damages enemies. Bombs (X when equipped): 2s fuse with pulse, 32px explosion radius dealing 2 dmg, friendly fire if too close, destroys weak walls. Weak-wall destruction triggers configured weak_wall_reward spawn (heart_piece in thicket_vine + ruins_north_b). C key cycles item slot through owned items. Bomb count tracked + displayed. HUD: hearts + rupees + key count + item slot.
combat.deliverable: Sword slash (4-axis, 8-frame anim, ~100ms windup + ~200ms active hitbox + ~150ms recovery), spin attack (hold 1.0s charge), bow + arrow (projectile pool of 8, embeds 0.5s), bombs (2s fuse, 32px radius, breaks weak-walls). Knockback 8px. 600ms i-frames flicker. Half-heart damage. Audio hooks: sfx_attack, sfx_hit, sfx_bow, sfx_bomb_explode.

enemies._progress: Iter #5: all 5 AI behaviors + Guardian 2-phase boss + enemy projectiles + radial-slam shockwave shipped. AIs: patrol (Thornback, reverses on solid), chase (Veilstalker w/ wall sidestep), shoot (Wraithwhisper hover-drift + 700ms telegraph + 2s fire CD), guard (Geomancer stationary + 600ms telegraph + 3s slam CD radial shockwave), charge (Crystalspine line-of-sight charge + wall-slam stun 600ms). Guardian boss: phase 1 chase + 3.5s slam CD wide-shockwave; phase 2 (auto-transitions at hp_phase1<=0) sword-immune (must bomb/arrow), 1.4x speed, fires cardinal 4-projectile burst every 4s. _damageEnemy refactored to take source='sword'|'arrow'|'bomb' for immunity gates. Telegraph visual = flash white. Enemy projectiles = 140px/s purple circles, despawn off-screen / after 3.5s / on wall hit. _clearRoomEntities now nukes bombs + projectiles + recycles arrows on room change.
enemies.deliverable: 5 enemy AI behaviors as a state-machine library: patrol (Thornback Lurker), chase (Veilstalker), shoot (Wraithwhisper — projectile every 2s with 1s telegraph), guard (Geomancer Statue mini-boss — slam attack on 3s cadence), boss (Guardian — phase 1 slash-vulnerable, phase 2 weak-wall-bomb-then-arrow). HP/DMG from design.md.

npcs_dialogue._progress: Iter #6: NPC dialogue modal UI + Liora NPC + bow gift. Liora added to thicket_waterfall (gives_bow_on_first_talk=true). C key is now context-sensitive: adjacent NPC = open dialogue, else cycle item slot. Dialogue suspends all gameplay (player input + AI), shows bottom-of-screen modal box w/ NPC name + line + blinking arrow, advances on Z/C/SPACE, closes on last-line advance. State picker: Heda (intro/in_progress/complete on side_quest_flowers), Mira (intro / after_dungeon on main_quest), Liora (intro → after_bow), default. Close-event side-effects: Mira's intro advances main_quest 'talk_to_mira' → 'enter_thicket'; Liora's intro gives bow + auto-equips. Bomb refill deferred (no bomb pickup yet).
npcs_dialogue.deliverable: 4 NPCs with multi-state dialogue. Elder Mira (quest-giver: Investigate Ruins → Return Relic), Dax the Trader (shop: 5 items, real rupee transactions), Liora (ally: gives map of Ruins, optional escort), Heda the Herbalist (side quest: 3 bioluminescent flowers in overworld). Dialogue tree: setHasSeen flag per topic.

hud_save.deliverable: Hearts (half-heart resolution, max 3 + 1 per heart container), rupees (counter + wallet 99/300/999), keys (small key count), item B-slot (boomerang/bow/bombs cycle). Save to localStorage on every checkpoint (entering a town room). New Game / Continue title menu. 3 save slots.

polish.deliverable: Screen shake on hit/boss-attack, hitstop 60ms, low-hearts beep, item-get fanfare, secret jingle on bombable-wall reveal. Music swap per zone: village (calm), overworld (level), dungeon (dungeon), boss (boss).

qa.deliverable: Chrome MCP playtest of critical path: title → new game → Mira intro → thicket → ruins entry → key room → mini-boss → dungeon item → puzzles → boss key → Guardian → heart container → win. Must run hands-off in <10 minutes. Screenshot every room. Fix any blocking bug discovered.

log.chunk: 5 AI behaviors + Guardian boss 2 phases + enemy projectile pool + radial slam shockwaves
log.what_done: pass2.js 1024→1276 lines. New: switch-based AI dispatch — patrol/chase/shoot/guard/charge + boss-specific dispatcher. Wraithwhisper hover-drift + telegraphed projectile every 2s. Geomancer 3s slam CD with 28-radius shockwave. Crystalspine charge AI (line-of-sight detection + 1.5s charge + wall-slam stun). Telegraph visual = white flash. Enemy projectiles purple circles 140px/s, 3.5s lifespan. _clearRoomEntities purges projectiles+bombs+recycles arrows on transition.

log.chunk: Bow (8-arrow pool) + bombs (2s fuse + 32px radius explosion + weak-wall destruction) + item-slot cycling + HUD upgrade
log.what_done: pass2.js grew 760 → 1024 lines. Added: arrow pool (8 max concurrent, embed-on-wall 500ms then recycle), bomb objects with fuse pulse + radial-damage explosion + weak-wall demolition with reward spawn (heart_piece on bombing), item-slot state (currentItem) + cycling on C key + use on X key, bombs count refilled by +4 per bomb pickup. Friendly-fire damage if player too close to bomb. _repaintTiles helper for live tile mutations. Combat phase deliverable fully met → marked done; queue popped to 5 phases. HUD upgraded: hearts + rupees + keys + item slot (top-right). HUD moved from tileLayer → fxLayer (fixes bug where room transitions destroyed HUD). Parse OK 1024 lines. Deployed to R2.
log.what_left: Bow currently has no in-game source room — players can't get bow until iter handles that. (Workaround: drop bow as Liora's gift in NPC iter, OR add a chest in thicket_waterfall.) Bomb refills (sub-item: bomb_pickup) not yet implemented; players have a finite 4-bomb supply from miniboss drop.
log.blockers: None. Combat fully done. Next: enemies phase (3 more AI behaviors: shoot/guard/boss).
